task.question: In which city will the 2026 UEFA Conference League final take place?

answer:

In which city will the 2026 UEFA Conference League final take place?

[en:2026 UEFA Conference League final] The 2026 UEFA Conference League final was the final match of the 2025–26 UEFA Conference League, the fifth season of Europe's tertiary club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the second season since it was renamed from the UEFA Europa Conference League to the UEFA Conference League. It was played at the Red Bull Arena in Leipzig, Germany, on 27 May 2026 between English club Crystal Palace and Spanish club Rayo Vallecano. Crystal Palace won the match 1–0 for their first UEFA Conference League title. As winners, they qualified for the league phase of the 2026–27 UEFA Europa League. | Other titles: ['2026–27 UEFA Conference League', '2028 UEFA Conference League final']

The 2026 UEFA Conference League final will take place at the Red Bull Arena in Leipzig, Germany.
